scoring_justification: J_calc cannot be recomputed in the verifier sandbox; compare reported J_calc to hidden experimental references with monotonic deviation-based scoring that enforces expected functional performance patterns.

hidden_assets.purpose: experimental 1JCH reference values for fluorocyclohexane (axial, equatorial) and 2-chloropyran (anomeric)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the published paper; embedded inline in grading_spec.json
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published experimental coupling constants from the source paper.

outputs.description: Computed 1JCH coupling constants in Hz. The hidden checker will compare each reported J_calc against experimental reference values, computing the deviation ΔJ = J_calc − J_exp. The score is based on whether the deviations fall within predetermined tolerance bands and reflect the expected functional performance trends.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker holds experimental 1JCH values for fluorocyclohexane (axial and equatorial) and 2-chloropyran (anomeric C-H). The tolerances are set to accommodate legitimate method-dependent variations arising from using ORCA instead of Gaussian 03.
